answer: Bind one hull serial and IMEI to one earning key; reuse voids both enrollments. The buoy may wander with pack ice off the tundra, yet before a published cutoff it must uplink a frame that embeds the public seed. One modem session cannot present two IMEIs during the same cutoff, so the next fake identity needs another buoy. Design-assumption costs only: $2,400 to buy a buoy and $55 monthly airtime, so 90 clones run $216,000 to start and $4,950 each month. A uniquely veined marble disc is potted into the hull at launch; a swapped shell fails the seal.
